chunks: It is narrated by al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, that he heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say:
Indeed, turning away breaks the salat (prayer) when it is done with the whole body.

key_terms.الِالْتِفَاتُ: turning away or shifting orientation during salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Does turning away during salat (prayer) invalidate the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer): full bodily turning away during the prayer invalidates it. It addresses one of the rulings related to forgetfulness and improper movement in prayer.
